name: compare-card
title: S9 对比进度小卡 (CompareCard)
description: 对比进度小卡（S9 · 尺寸 S）— 两项数值对比条 · 差值

files.content: import { Tile } from '@/components/ui/tile' import { HUE_PALETTES, TILE_THEMES, type Hue, type TileTone } from '@/lib/tokens' export interface CompareCardProps { label: string delta: string primary: { label: string; value: number; display?: string } secondary: { label: string; value: number; display?: string } tone?: TileTone } export function CompareCard({ label, delta, primary, secondary, tone = 'mint', }: CompareCardProps) { const theme = TILE_THEMES[tone] const maxVal = Math.max(primary.value, secondary.value, 1) const pPct = Math.round((primary.value / maxVal) * 100) const sPct = Math.round((secondary.value / maxVal) * 100) const mutedFill = tone === 'white' ? '#CDD3DD' : tone in HUE_PALETTES ? HUE_PALETTES[tone as Hue][300] : theme.mutedBar return ( {label} {delta} {primary.label} {primary.display ?? primary.value.toLocaleString('en-US')} {secondary.label} {secondary.display ?? secondary.value.toLocaleString('en-US')} ) }
